newsitem.title: FRANCE: French 97 deficit seen at 3.2 pct of GDP-committee.
newsitem.headline: French 97 deficit seen at 3.2 pct of GDP-committee.

text.p: A technical committee within France's accounts auditing commission has an average forecast of 3.2 percent for France's public deficit as a proportion of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in 1997, according to an official document obtained by Reuters.
The forecast is based on a sample of eight economic forecasting houses.
France's official government forecast is for the public deficits to be 2.9 percent of GDP in 1997.
The groups used by the technical committee in drawing up the average forecast are BIPE, CDC, COE, GAMA, Rexecode, OFCE, AFEDE and Expansion.
